content.short: PeckShield is a blockchain security firm offering audits, pen tests, threat monitoring.
content.description: Founded in 2018, PeckShield is a blockchain security company that provides comprehensive security services for the ecosystem. They offer security audits for smart contracts, DeFi protocols, exchanges, and wallets; ongoing threat monitoring and prevention; as well as penetration testing and rapid emergency response when incidents occur. Their clients include Polygon, BNB Chain, Bancor, 1inch, OKChain, and dYdX, underscoring their role in safeguarding diverse blockchain projects and ecosystems.
content.meta: PeckShield provides audits, pen tests, and threat monitoring for blockchain security. Discover PeckShield and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
